title: React 18 introduces breaking changes requiring migration - automatic batching, strict mode changes, new root API
summary: React 18 introduces breaking changes including: automatic batching (previously opt-in), strict mode double-invoking effects in development, new createRoot API replacing render, and deprecated APIs removed. Migration requires code changes for affected applications.

evidences.excerpt: React 18 introduces automatic batching (fewer re-renders), new root API (createRoot replaces render), strict mode changes (double-invoking effects in dev), and deprecated APIs removed (ReactDOM.render, etc.). Migration guide provided for upgrading from React 17.

React 18.0.0 release notes: Automatic batching for all state updates, createRoot API, strict mode changes, new hooks (useId, useTransition, useDeferredValue), deprecated APIs removed. Migration guide: https://react.dev/blog/2022/06/15/react-v18-upgrade-guide

Migration guide for React 18: Replace ReactDOM.render with createRoot, update strict mode usage, handle automatic batching changes, migrate deprecated APIs. Codemods available for automated migration assistance.
